title: Quantitative PCR (qPCR) Protocol
author: Camille Goldman
materials: Lyse cells in TRIzol (Invitrogen 15596018). For 1 well of a 6-well plate, use 300 uL of TRIzol

steps.title: Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using a kit following the manufacturer's recommendations (e.g., Zymo R2062).

substeps.instruction: Freeze TRIzol lysate or proceed immediately to the next step.

steps.title: Quantify and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration and purity of the extracted RNA using a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Prepare RNA Samples
steps.instruction: Thaw RNA on ice if not continuing directly from extraction. In a PCR tube, add 1 ug of RNA and nuclease free water up to 10 uL (RNA amount may be lowered if concentration is low).

steps.title: Prepare Reverse Transcription Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reverse transcription master mix with the following components per reaction:

substeps.instruction: 50 U Maxima H Minus Reverse Transcriptase (Thermo Scientific EP0752)

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Add 10 uL of the master mix to each RNA sample and incubate.

steps.title: Store and Dilute cDNA
steps.instruction: Store cDNA at -20°C. When ready, thaw cDNA on ice and dilute 1:10 in nuclease free water.

steps.title: Prepare Primer Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare primer mixes containing 10uM of forward primer and 10uM of reverse primer in nuclease free water.

steps.title: Set Up qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: In each well of a 384 well plate, combine the following to a final volume of 10uL:

substeps.instruction: 2X PowerUp SYBR Green Master Mix (Applied Biosystems A25741)
1uM each of forward and reverse primers

steps.title: Run qPCR Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the qPCR using the following cycle parameters:

substeps.instruction: 40 cycles of 15 seconds at 95°C and 1 minute at 60°C

steps.title: Perform Optional Melting Curve
steps.instruction: Optionally, include a melting curve stage.
